cost: For D replayed deltas, M mentions, E events, C cursors, K characters and L output bytes: state/history O(D+L), attention O(M+K log K), context adds O(E+C) and O(E) references. diff adds sorting and quadratic vector membership for set deltas. Resolve replays relevant entities and compares words/alternatives. Label recursion/ancestry cost depends on structure; cycles excluded.
description: Immutable queries project snapshots, histories, labels, resolution and attention/context. state_at/holder_at delegate replay to Entity. qa.rs calls context_at/where_at/holder_at; md.rs renders context. Text-to-frame extraction is not performed here.

inverse: U is (finite well-formed W, query q, typed return y) for terminating immutable calls; R is y=Q(W,q). Inner bound of U minus R: state_at returning a version absent from the entity, attention containing zero-count/non-character IDs, diff returning Some for zero/out-of-range endpoints.
Q^-1(y)={(W,q):Q(W,q)=y}; retain every compatible unobserved state, mention and event. Strings lose provenance; bounded-world enumeration is a proposed oracle, not unique recovery.
